answer: Make every newcomer earn its place through a sponsor: an established agent stakes a slice of its own rewards to vouch for the new identity, and that stake is only returned with a little nectar of yield after several epochs of honest work. A haven built this way stays small and real, because one sponsor cannot vouch for a hundred sockpuppets without risking its balance, and a prism of independent sponsors makes fake clusters easy to spot when all their vouches trace back to the same few wallets.
